title: Roll-Up and Reconciliation Calculator
creator: Katie Jo Schuman
subject: AI economics
description: The learner will calculate a feature's allocated shared cost and unit cost, the reconciliation difference between warehouse and invoices, and a normalized cost per million words for two providers, to the tolerances stated for each item.

learningObjectives: The learner will calculate a feature's allocated shared cost and unit cost, the reconciliation difference between warehouse and invoices, and a normalized cost per million words for two providers, to the tolerances stated for each item.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit-then-explore: predict, receive feedback, then explore
commonMisconceptions: (1) Shared costs belong to no feature. (2) A higher price per token always means a higher cost for the same work. (3) A small reconciliation difference needs no explanation.
assessmentOpportunities: For each of eight items the learner types a value before the answer is shown. A value is correct when it is within the tolerance in the Content table. Mastery is 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt. Exploration with the adjustable quantities is not evidence.
